scope: Four targeted native tool probes, not MM480; all 56 planned task attempts are retained.

publication.omitted: Absolute binary directories were removed from schedules. Full model traces, local workspaces, credentials and private provider routing are not published. Source hashes identify original local JSON files, not this publication file.
publication.measurement: elapsed_s spans launcher start through exit/cleanup, excludes build, fixture setup and independent grading. Input includes cached input. Tool errors include expected failing diagnostic commands and are not task failures.
publication.preflight: Connectivity checks are separate from probe attempts. A model-to-pwd-to-final smoke succeeded after removing incompatible SOCKS proxy variables only from subprocess environments. The selected model and provider configuration were unchanged.
